player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Nim.
Your goal is to take the last remaining object.
On each turn, choose exactly one pile and remove one or more objects from it.
Use the format '[pile quantity]', where pile is the pile index and quantity is the number of objects to remove.
For example, '[0 3]' removes 3 objects from pile 0.

state.current_pile: Kisika ya bo ke salaka bansaka: {piles}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Bo me mona ve mutindu ya mbote ya kutinda. Sadila "[pile quantity]".

invalid_move.out_of_range: Index ya bibende {pile_index} kele na nganda.

observation.removed_from_piles: Mwana {player_id} wakala [{pile_index} {quantity}], kuima {quantity} kisika (bisika) na kisika {pile_index}.

outcome.win: Muntu ya kebula {player_id} mebaka kima yina bo zengaka na nsuka!
